purpose: Group existing candidates by player decision, causality, persistent resources/world state and directed travel responsibilities; reduce first human-review repetition while preserving useful interfaces.
scope: Only32 selected_for_plains_candidates=true versions. Nine advanced, one already pacing-held and other unclassified catalog rows are outside this batch.

definitions.representative: Primary exact version chosen for a group human-review clip, not a human endorsement.
definitions.useful_adapter: Same decision family, retained for an explicit tested demand, distinct output direction or concrete role/contract. Does not add a family.
definitions.redundant_variant: Omit from this first human-review playlist because same decision/state/route semantics are already represented and no independent demand was found. Keep original library and spatial search value; no global dominance claim.
definitions.needs_review: Insufficient binding/decision evidence to choose safely; none forced into success.
definitions.pacing_held: Model video pacing hold only; no physical or human rejection implied.

criteria: Player observation and consequential choice, not titles or seeds.
Causal effect of recoil, projectile, contact, enemy or timer separately.
Resource source/expenditure and persistent world-state role.
Exact directed route set and continuous return evidence.
Useful known requirement/role may preserve an adapter; coordinate difference alone never creates a family.
Representative choice uses traceability and review coverage, not invented human preference.

feedback_scope.D01_new_proposal: User described new proposalD01 as redundant. This is proposal feedback, not invalidation of existing basic recoil material.
feedback_scope.D02_D05: Positive design impression only; unimplemented proposals contribute no candidate versions or family count.
feedback_scope.earlier20: Overall positive video impression only, no invented per-item score.
